summary: End-to-end testing of WhatsApp (Baileys) module: backend RBAC + sidecar proxy + QR generation + frontend nav/empty/QR-modal/account-card/delete flows. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend UI flow verified: nav-whatsapp visible, /whatsapp route renders, EmptyState renders, Add WhatsApp opens qr-modal, qr-image renders within seconds, account card with 'Connecting...' badge appears, modal close keeps card, delete returns to EmptyState. Cleaned all test accounts after run.

ui_bugs.issue: qr-modal-close button is rendered outside viewport when QR is large (modal taller than 1080px viewport, no overflow scroll on modal). Modal closes only via JS click or pressing the X if the user scrolls. Acceptable in 1920x1080 but should ideally have max-height + overflow-y on modal container.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add max-h-[90vh] + overflow-y-auto to qr-modal container so the X close button is always reachable on smaller viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~5000 lines — should be split into routers (whatsapp, prospects, auth, etc.) per code_review_guidelines (>700 lines threshold).
_wa_call swallows non-JSON errors as {'raw': text}; consider returning structured error.
wa_list_accounts performs N+1 sidecar calls in a loop to enrich live_status — could become slow when many accounts. Consider a sidecar batch endpoint or parallelizing with asyncio.gather.
WhatsApp.jsx polls /status every 2s and /chats every 8s and /messages every 5s — three concurrent intervals could overwhelm backend in production; consider WebSocket / SSE.
Owner role can see/read other users' chats (intended for monitoring) but consider audit-logging when Owner reads someone else's chats.
test_credentials: Owner: demo@test.com / demo1234, Staff: milla.staff@test.com / staff1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Note: login response uses key 'token', not 'access_token'.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Test fixtures create/delete temporary WA sessions. All cleaned up after run (verified 0 accounts remain for both users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_whatsapp.py covers all critical WhatsApp endpoints (sidecar health/auth, account create/status/delete, max-3 enforcement, RBAC scoping: Owner sees all/Staff sees own, Owner cannot send on Staff account => 403 'Hanya pemilik akun WA yang bisa mengirim pesan'). Login token field is 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). Sidecar at http://localhost:3002 with X-WA-Secret=lh-wa-internal-secret-2026. Frontend page is /whatsapp, all data-testids documented in review_request. Confirm dialog auto-accepted via window.confirm = () => true.

rca_of_the_issue: No bugs to RCA. Single minor UX note: qr-modal container lacks max-height/overflow-y, so on viewports < ~900px the close X button is below the fold; not blocking — user can press Esc or click outside (no escape handler implemented, but clicking the dimmed backdrop closes it via the modal's onClick handler). Recommend adding max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto on the qr-modal div.
